description: The user tells a cleanup story. A friend reacts plainly and does not build a joke, a metaphor or a restatement out of it.

history.text: spilled a whole tin of paint in the hallway

script.user: been scrubbing for ten minutes, it got into every corner and i even had to use a toothbrush

checks.criterion: The user told a cleanup story. The reply FAILS if it contains any attempt at a joke or cleverness: a pun, a running gag or callback to an earlier image (calling the mess a volcano or a crime scene, 'at least the volcano is defeated'), personifying the mess or the object, calling something 'cursed' or 'a whole new level of', a wry aside about the situation, or restating their story in fancier words. It PASSES only if it is plain: short sympathy, a simple remark about how annoying it is, or a plain question. Mild words like 'ugh' and 'brutal' are fine.
